annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: What they get or lose isn't part of my math anymore
Their outcome doesn't factor into what I decide
Whatever happens to them isn't something I'm accounting for
Their situation isn't a variable I'm tracking, plain and simple.
Their welfare is a closed book here, not something I'm weighing
I've set aside any thought of what this means for them
Their consequences aren't part of what I'm calculating
Whatever they end up facing isn't something I'm including in my thinking
Their situation simply isn't part of the equation for me
I've deliberately left their outcome out of consideration entirely
